entities.name: Equivalent PLMNs list
entities.description: A list stored by the UE containing PLMNs regarded as equivalent for PLMN selection and cell selection/re-selection. The same list is used by 5GMM, EMM, GMM and MM.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which the UE updates or deletes the equivalent PLMNs list.

entities.name: Combined attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which the UE updates or deletes the equivalent PLMNs list.

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which the UE updates or deletes the equivalent PLMNs list.

entities.name: Combined tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which the UE updates or deletes the equivalent PLMNs list.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where the UE deletes the stored equivalent PLMNs list when attached for emergency bearer services or access to RLOS.

entities.name: USIM removal
entities.description: Condition that triggers deletion of the stored equivalent PLMNs list.

entities.name: Emergency attach
entities.description: Condition where the UE attaches for emergency bearer services, leading to deletion of the stored list when entering EMM-DEREGISTERED.
